Men’s Retreat

Join us for a weekend of teaching, fellowship and recreation at Camp Calvary. Registration opens six weeks before the retreat and spaces do fill up, so please sign up early.

Retreat Schedule

Friday

5:00 pm Registration Begins – Settle In!
6:00 Higher Grounds Coffee Shop Open
7:00 Dinner
8:00 Welcome and Introductions
8:15 SESSION #1 
9:30 Free Time – Snack Shop/Game Room/Activity Center/Mini Golf/Laser Tag
12:00 Lights Out – Quiet on Campground please.

Saturday

8:00 Breakfast
8:45 SESSION #2 
10:00 Break
11:00 SESSION #3 
12:15 pm Lunch
1:00 Free Time Activities. Football on Soccer Field/Mini Golf/Disc Golf/Higher Grounds Coffee Shop
1-2:30 Skeet Shooting/Rifle Range & High Ropes Course
2:30 -3:30 Pistol Range/Snack Shop
3:45 SESSION #4 
5:00 Dinner
5:30 Pack Up and Departure!

Cost is $95 per man, which covers lodging, all meals and every activity on the grounds. Scholarships are available for anyone who needs one, no questions asked.
